scientific_integrity: The proof combines an unbounded divisor-sum reduction with a finite exhaustive exact-arithmetic certificate and an explicit six-prime divisor witness. The six-prime example is credited to existing literature.
scientific_limitations: Only odd squarefree integers; no classification of larger prime support; the five-prime case requires 87 exact finite subset-sum checks. Priority against all unindexed literature remains uncertain.
title: The sharp six-prime lower bound for odd squarefree strongly pseudoperfect integers
